facts.fact: 暗门在红披山体一侧留下一道破坏的痕迹，阿拉里克一行必须尽快离开敌方领地。
facts.anchor: The Shadowgate had carved a path of destruction along one side of the red-draped mountain.

facts.fact: 阿拉里克派伊莱丝取回她的狼形小艇、返回伊安塔斯盯住局势。
facts.anchor: Alaric dispatched Ileis to retrieve her wolf coracle and return to Iantas in order to keep an eye on things.

facts.fact: 塔拉辛在船舱里单独告诉阿拉里克，欧雅尔趁她倒地时给她注射了血清，夺走了光织，她已无法施展以太魔法。
facts.anchor: As I was lying there, on the floor, she injected me with—something. A type of serum. It took the Lightweave away. I can’t aethermance.

facts.fact: 无月之暗前一个月，阿拉里克从父亲手中救回了被偷走的萨里曼鸟。
facts.anchor: In the month before the Moonless Dark, Alaric had rescued the stolen sariman from his father’s clutches.

facts.fact: 高上尉向塔拉辛建议烧掉山间旅舍与周边，不留任何证据。
facts.anchor: That we torch the lodge and its surroundings, Lachis’ka. Leave no evidence.

facts.fact: 塔拉辛以火树需三十年成材为由拒绝纵火，说丝兰地人靠这片森林为生。
facts.anchor: It takes a single fire tree thirty years to mature.

facts.fact: 塔拉辛想到，一旦说出乌尔杜贾杀她母亲的事，就会牵出哈南·伊夫拉利斯曾促成内纳瓦伦战舰援救日庭光织者。
facts.anchor: It would come out that Hanan Ivralis had been instrumental in the Nenavarene warships sailing to the Sunstead Lightweavers’ aid.

facts.fact: 塔拉辛压低声音要苏拉克威尔替她联络全fold、安排一次会面。
facts.anchor: I need you to contact the Allfold for me. Set up a meeting.
